sloka: द्वीपं शाखामृगश्रेष्ठो मलयोपवनानि च ।सागरं सागरानूपं सागरानूपजान् द्रुमान् ॥५-१-२०२॥
transliteration: dvīpaṁ śākhāmṛgaśreṣṭho malayopavanāni ca ।sāgaraṁ sāgarānūpaṁ sāgarānūpajān drumān ॥5-1-202॥

translations.english: He surveyed the ocean, its shores, the trees born upon those shores, and the mouths of the ocean's wives as well.
